newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate tilts toward budget amendment.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate tilts toward budget amendment.

text.p: Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle said Monday the balanced budget amendment to the U.S. Constitution would likely pass the Senate if the vote were held now and will be very close when it is taken next month.
"There are a number of people who are undecided," he told reporters. "I say it is too close to call although I expect that today the amendment would probably pass," he said.

To press their opposition against the amendment, President Clinton will send a letter to lawmakers to address concerns about the potential harm to Social Security from the Republican-drafted amendment.
